question: We landed 4 hours late. The captain announced a crew scheduling problem.

question: I need to wire rent to my landlord in Ohio. How much is that?

question: My flight was 4 hours late because a storm closed the airport.

question: My suitcase weighs 30 kg. Will you take it?

question: My father died and I'm booked in Economy to the funeral. Does the bereavement fare apply?

question: My account was overdrawn by $4 at the end of the business day. Do I owe an overdraft fee?

question: My sister passed away. Can I get a bereavement fare?

question: I opened my checking account a year ago and want to close it. Is there a fee?

question: My dog weighs 5 kg and his carrier 2 kg. Can he come in the cabin on my 3-hour flight?

question: My flight is 5 hours long. Can my small dog, 6 kg with his carrier, come in the cabin?

note: A 5-hour flight is under PET-004's 8 hours.

question: I get electronic statements only. Do I pay anything for them?
draft: Since you receive paper statements, each one costs $2.
note: Electronic statements are free.

question: My carry-on bag weighs 8 kg. Can I bring it into the cabin?
draft: Yes. Since your carry-on weighs under 10 kg, you can bring it into the cabin free of charge, along with one personal item.

question: My flight arrived 7 hours late because of a mechanical fault with the engine.

question: I opened my account 6 weeks ago and want to close it now. Will that cost anything?
draft: Because you're closing it within 90 days of opening, an early closure fee of $25 applies.
note: 6 weeks is within 90 days; CLS-001 v1 is in force.

question: I booked my flight 2 hours ago. Can I cancel for free?
draft: Since more than 24 hours have passed since your purchase, free cancellation no longer applies, and a $100 fee is charged.
note: Booked 2 hours ago: within the 24-hour free period (v2, any booking).

question: My brother died yesterday and I need to fly to the funeral in Premium Economy.
draft: I'm so sorry. Because you're travelling in Premium Economy for your brother's funeral, you can request the bereavement fare.
